audit.whatIsWrong: Three fabricated names ran through this matchup: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' (Hwei's E is Subject: Torment), 'Countless Twisted Shadows' (his R is Spiraling Despair), and 'Void Stone's shield' unlocking at level 9 (Void Stone is Kassadin's passive and only reduces magic damage — the shield is on Null Sphere from level 1). Content also credited a root to Hwei's W; Subject: Serenity is the utility palette and his crowd control lives on Subject: Torment.
audit.why: Riot's kit text names the palettes Subject: Disaster (Q, 10/9/8/7/6s), Subject: Serenity (W, 18-16s), Subject: Torment (E, 12-10s) and Spiraling Despair (R, 120/100/80s). Signature of the Visionary detonates when a SECOND damaging spell lands on you, which is the real reason a single paint is survivable and two are not.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced with the real one across focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, cooldowns, feeding, dos/donts and the content spikes and prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer said 'Skill' at rows 2-5 while content and the packet chart give Hwei rows 2-4 and Kassadin row 5.
audit.why: Hwei paints from well outside 650 with a 10s Disaster palette, and Spiraling Despair at 1300 range catches a Riftwalk, so level 6 is still his. At first item the palette cooldowns (10s and 12s) become gaps Riftwalk can enter.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-4 set to Hwei and row 5 to Kassadin on the full layer, with all four whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike list hung Kassadin's power on a non-existent level 9 passive shield.
audit.why: Kassadin's shield is Null Sphere's, available from level 1 and scaling with rank; the real first-item spike is affording the shield often enough to eat a paint per trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[2], whys[5], late and wants.you[0] rewritten around Null Sphere.

audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12s at rank 1, Subject: Disaster 10s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5, Spiraling Despair 120s at rank 1.

notes: This matchup carried the worst fabrication load in the slice: 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' is not an ability (E is Subject: Torment), 'Countless Twisted Shadows' is not an ability (R is Spiraling Despair), and 'Void Stone's shield at level 9' is wrong twice over — Void Stone is Kassadin's magic-damage-reduction passive and the shield is Null Sphere's. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Void Stone's' as a near-miss name; the name is real but the claim attached to it was not.
